job-application-grade-and-award.title: Grade and award verification
job-application-grade-and-award.purpose: Use when an employer needs the graduate identity, institution, degree, year, and final grade for an academic screening pass.

policyRationale.requireGraduateNameDisclosure: Bind the application to the named graduate before an employer starts academic screening.
policyRationale.requireUniversityNameDisclosure: Show which issuer minted the diploma so the employer can apply institution-specific trust rules.
policyRationale.requireAwardNameDisclosure: Expose the degree title needed to match the applicant against the hiring stream.
policyRationale.requireGraduationYearDisclosure: Expose the completion year needed for cohort and recency checks.
policyRationale.requireFinalGradeDisclosure: Expose the raw final grade because this screening preset explicitly compares academic performance.

job-application-honors-without-grade.title: Honors without raw grade
job-application-honors-without-grade.purpose: Use when an employer needs degree context and honors classification but intentionally avoids collecting the raw final grade.

policyRationale.requireGraduateNameDisclosure: Bind the application to the named graduate before an employer starts academic screening.
policyRationale.requireUniversityNameDisclosure: Show which issuer minted the diploma so the employer can apply institution-specific trust rules.
policyRationale.requireAwardNameDisclosure: Expose the degree title needed to match the applicant against the hiring stream.
policyRationale.requireGraduationYearDisclosure: Expose the completion year needed for cohort and recency checks.
policyRationale.requireHonorsCodeDisclosure: Expose honors classification as a coarse performance band.
policyRationale.requireFinalGradeDisclosure: Keep the raw final grade private because this preset only needs honors classification.

job-application-credits-and-grade.title: Credits and grade verification
job-application-credits-and-grade.purpose: Use when an employer needs the degree outcome plus the earned-credit total to compare curriculum depth across graduates.

policyRationale.requireGraduateNameDisclosure: Bind the application to the named graduate before an employer starts academic screening.
policyRationale.requireUniversityNameDisclosure: Show which issuer minted the diploma so the employer can apply institution-specific trust rules.
policyRationale.requireAwardNameDisclosure: Expose the degree title needed to match the applicant against the hiring stream.
policyRationale.requireGraduationYearDisclosure: Expose the completion year needed for cohort and recency checks.
policyRationale.requireCreditsEarnedDisclosure: Expose earned credits so the employer can compare curriculum depth across universities.
policyRationale.requireFinalGradeDisclosure: Expose the raw final grade because this preset compares both grade and curriculum depth.

mall-discount-grade-over-90.title: Grade-above-90 discount
mall-discount-grade-over-90.purpose: Use when a verifier needs institution identity plus a strict grade threshold check for a student discount offer.

policyRationale.requireUniversityNameDisclosure: Show the student belongs to the trusted university population eligible for the mall offer.
policyRationale.requireFinalGradeDisclosure: Expose the final grade because the offer is defined by a strict grade threshold.
policyRationale.enforceMinimumFinalGrade: Apply the business rule in verifier logic instead of relying on a self-attested statement.
policyRationale.minimumFinalGrade: Use 91 to represent a greater-than-90 threshold with integer fixture grades.
